# Suffice Desktop

Electron desktop application for the shared local Suffice harness.

- UI: apps/desktop/src; shared design tokens, glass controls and saved backgrounds.
- Local backend: Electron utility process, through narrow isolated preload IPC.
- Shared implementation: packages/harness exports the existing packages/cli runtime. One harness source is maintained.
- Choose a project with the folder button; Agent mode submits prompts and streams results; Stop cancels; New session resets context.
- Existing CLI credentials and harness session receipts stay under ~/.suffice, outside renderer access.
- Saved thread transcripts and native session resume are connected. Plan/Ask modes, archive UI, attachments and native login are not yet connected. Installer distribution is deferred.
- Browser-only runs remain visual previews; the live harness requires Electron.
- Run bun install and bun run desktop from the repository root; workspaces share one root node_modules.
